intro: Both forms name what something is built from. に基づいて is the foundation underneath: the facts, rules or data that a judgement or action rests on and must stay true to. をもとに is the raw material: a starting point you take and reshape into something new, such as a novel, a film, a menu or a design.

skills.rule: Facts, data, rules or experience + に基づいて + a judgement or action: based on, grounded in, and staying faithful to that basis.
skills.explain:
に基づいて says what a decision, judgement, rule or piece of work rests on: データに基づいて判断する, 法律に基づいて処分する, 実話に基づいた映画. The basis is solid and authoritative (facts, evidence, a law, a contract, a survey, experience), and the result must stay faithful to it.

Directly before a noun it becomes に基づく or に基づいた: 調査に基づく報告書, 経験に基づいたアドバイス. The style is formal and common in business, law and journalism. Note the particle: it is に基づいて, never を基づいて.

The edge with をもとに: both translate as "based on", but に基づいて is about justification (the result is backed by the basis and consistent with it), while をもとに is about raw material (you take something as a starting point and make something new). Laws, rules and contracts take に基づいて. With に沿って the image is a line you follow, not a foundation you stand on.
patterns: [data / facts / law / contract] に基づいて [判断する / 決める / 処分する]
[basis] に基づく / に基づいた [noun]

examples.jp: データ{にもとづいて}判断[はんだん]してください。
examples.en: Please make your judgement on the basis of the data.

examples.jp: この映画[えいが]は実話[じつわ]{にもとづいて}います。
examples.en: This film is based on a true story.

examples.jp: 調査[ちょうさ]の結果[けっか]{にもとづいて}、計画[けいかく]を決[き]めました。
examples.en: We decided on the plan based on the results of the survey.

examples.jp: 経験[けいけん]{にもとづいた}アドバイスはとても役[やく]に立[た]つ。
examples.en: Advice based on experience is very useful.

examples.jp: 契約[けいやく]{にもとづいて}、料金[りょうきん]をお支払[しはら]いします。
examples.en: We will pay the fee in accordance with the contract.

examples.jp: 法律[ほうりつ]{にもとづいて}、厳[きび]しく処分[しょぶん]します。
examples.en: We will deal with it strictly in accordance with the law.

contrast.note: をもとに takes something as raw material to create from: 昔話をもとに小説を書いた (wrote a novel from a folk tale). The result may depart freely. に基づいて requires the result to stay true to the basis, so laws and rules take に基づいて.
に沿って follows a line or plan step by step (マニュアルに沿って作業する). に基づいて stands on evidence or rules as its justification.
に従って means obeying (係員の指示に従う) or changing in step (年を取るに従って). It is about compliance or proportion, not about what a conclusion rests on.

mistakes.bad: データ{にもとづく}判断[はんだん]してください。
mistakes.good: データ{にもとづいて}判断[はんだん]してください。
mistakes.note: Before a verb, use the て-form; に基づく goes only directly before a noun (データに基づく判断).

mistakes.bad: 調査[ちょうさ]の結果[けっか]{をもとづいて}、計画[けいかく]を決[き]めました。
mistakes.good: 調査[ちょうさ]の結果[けっか]{にもとづいて}、計画[けいかく]を決[き]めました。
mistakes.note: 基づく takes に, never を. Do not blend it with をもとに.

skills.tip: Must the result stay true to the basis (facts, law, data, contract)? Then に基づいて.

skills.rule: Noun + をもとに(して) + a verb of making: using that as the source or starting point to create something new.
skills.explain:
をもとに treats something as the raw material or starting point for making something new: 昔話をもとに映画を作る, アンケートの結果をもとに新商品を開発する, 自分の体験をもとに小説を書く. The verb after it is usually one of creating or composing: 作る, 書く, 描く, 考える, 開発する. をもとにして means the same.

The particle is を, because もと (basis, source) is the object: X をもとに means "taking X as the source". Learners often say にもとに by analogy with に基づいて; that is wrong.

Directly before a noun it becomes をもとにした: 実話をもとにした映画. The result may change, add to or freely rework the source; that is the point.

The edge with に基づいて: に基づいて is justification, the result must stay faithful to an authoritative basis (a law, rules, a contract). をもとに is material that gets transformed. With data and facts both are common. With を中心に, the noun is the centre of an activity (若者を中心に人気がある, popular mainly among young people), not its source.
patterns: [source] をもとに [作る / 書く / 描く / 考える / 開発する]

examples.jp: この写真[しゃしん]{をもとに}、絵[え]を描[か]きました。
examples.en: I painted a picture from this photo.

examples.jp: 祖母[そぼ]の話[はなし]{をもとに}、小説[しょうせつ]を書[か]いた。
examples.en: I wrote a novel based on my grandmother's stories.

examples.jp: アンケートの結果[けっか]{をもとに}、新[あたら]しいメニューを考[かんが]えました。
examples.en: We came up with a new menu based on the survey results.

examples.jp: これは実話[じつわ]{をもとにした}映画[えいが]です。
examples.en: This is a film based on a true story.

examples.jp: お客様[きゃくさま]の意見[いけん]{をもとに}、商品[しょうひん]を改良[かいりょう]しました。
examples.en: We improved the product based on customer feedback.

contrast.note: に基づいて means the result is justified by and faithful to the basis: 法律に基づいて判断する. をもとに uses the source as material that can be reshaped: 民話をもとにアニメを作る.
を中心に marks the centre or main part of something: 関東を中心に雨が降る (rain mainly over the Kanto region). It says nothing about a source.
をめぐって marks an issue people argue or compete over: 土地をめぐって争う. It never introduces material for creating something.

mistakes.bad: 昔話[むかしばなし]{にもとに}、劇[げき]を作[つく]りました。
mistakes.good: 昔話[むかしばなし]{をもとに}、劇[げき]を作[つく]りました。
mistakes.note: もと is the object here, so the particle is を, unlike に基づいて.

mistakes.bad: 遺産[いさん]{をもとに}兄弟[きょうだい]が争[あらそ]った。
mistakes.good: 遺産[いさん]{をめぐって}兄弟[きょうだい]が争[あらそ]った。
mistakes.note: The inheritance is what the brothers fought over, not material they made something from: をめぐって.

skills.tip: Did someone take X and make something new out of it? Then X をもとに.
